an6.75:1.1: Chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ sa-upāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā.
an6.75:1.3: Kāmavitakkena, vyāpādavitakkena, vihiṃsāvitakkena, kāmasaññāya, vyāpādasaññāya, vihiṃsāsaññāya.
an6.75:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ sa-upāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā. 3.
an6.75:2.1: Chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭh'eva dhamme sukhaṃ viharati avighātaṃ anupāyāsaṃ apariḷāhaṃ, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugati pāṭikaṅkhā. 4.
an6.75:2.3: Nekkhammavitakkena, avyāpādavitakkena, avihiṃsāvitakkena, nekkhammasaññāya, avyāpādasaññāya, avihiṃsāsaññāya.
an6.75:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭh'eva dhamme sukhaṃ viharati avighātaṃ anupāyāsaṃ apariḷāhaṃ, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugati pāṭikaṅkhā
